maintenance.title: Maintenance notice
maintenance.toggleHint: A yellow strip at the top of every panel and of the public site, for everyone signed in or not.
maintenance.placeholder: Payroll exports are paused until 9pm while we move the reporting database.
maintenance.count: {count}/500. Empty falls back to a general notice — say what is affected and until when if you can.
maintenance.notLock: This is a notice, not a lock. Everyone can still sign in and every screen still works — the banner only tells them something is going on.

globalSettings.defaultsNote: These are defaults. Anyone who has set their own timezone, language, date format or currency under Settings keeps theirs — changing these moves everyone who never picked, which is nearly everyone.

logs.title: System Logs
logs.subtitle: Every write, as the database saw it
logs.loadFailed: Could not load the audit trail. Refresh to try again.
logs.footnote: Written by a database trigger, so a change made in the SQL editor or by a script is here too — not only what went through the app. Values are recorded for platform and content tables; for everything else the trail names the columns that changed but not what they hold, so patient and payroll data is not copied into a second place. Nothing here can be edited or deleted, by anyone.
logs.valuesNotRecorded: Values are not recorded for this table — the trail says which columns changed, not what they hold.

hospitals.title: Hospital Management
hospitals.subtitle: Every hospital, filtered by status
hospitals.requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
hospitals.alreadyProvisioned: {email} already has the admin login for this hospital.
hospitals.approveTitle: Approve and create the admin login
hospitals.resetBody: {name} was approved before its password could be stored, so there is nothing to show. The old password can't be recovered, only replaced. Resetting sets a new one you can view here from now on — and locks out whoever is using the old one.
hospitals.provisionBody: {name} is already approved but never had an admin login created, so there is nothing to show. Creating one now generates the password you can view here from now on. It uses the hospital's main email — or the owner's — as the username, so add one first if neither is set.
hospitals.credsSaved: {hospital}'s admin can sign in with these. Share them securely — you can come back to the key icon on this row and view them again at any time.
hospitals.credsOnce: {hospital}'s admin can sign in with these. Share them securely — saving this password for later failed, so it is shown only once. Copy it now, or use the key icon on the row to reset it.

billing.deleteBody: {no} for {hospital} would be gone for good, and the month would be free to bill again. If it was raised in error, void it instead — a cancelled invoice number is easier to explain than a missing one.
